symptom: On Mendix 9.x to 11.1, `alter workflow M.W { set (Targeting: xpath […]) on Task; }`, and the deprecated `set activity 'Task' targeting …` form, printed 'Altered workflow' and changed nothing. describe showed the old targeting, and mx check stayed clean, because the old targeting was still valid
cause: Mutator.SetActivityProperty set the targeting with bsonnav.DSet(actDoc, "UserTargeting", …), and DSet only replaces a key that already exists. Below 11.2 a stored user task holds its targeting as UserSource, so no key matched, nothing changed, and the op returned nil
file: `mdl/backend/wfmutator/mutator.go` (setUserTargeting: replaces UserTargeting or UserSource in place, else appends; the write lowers it per version in canon.LowerToProjectShape)
insight: **A setter that only replaces an existing key is a silent no-op on a document in another version's shape.** bsonnav.DSet reports false, and every caller here ignored it. When a storage key is renamed at a version (ako/mxcli#1771: UserSource → UserTargeting at 11.2), grep the raw mutators for the new key: each one that DSets it is broken on the older versions, and the success message hides it. Have the mutator write the CURRENT shape in place of whichever key holds the fact, and let canon.LowerToProjectShape convert it. A second copy of the old shape in the mutator would be a second mapping to keep in step. **The control needs a pre-fix binary for the exact bug-test**: rebuilding with the committed file swapped in (go build -o scratch) showed 'Altered workflow' x2 with `[Name = 'admin']` kept on 9.24.30 and 10.24.24. Measured after the fix: 9.24.30 and 10.24.24 describe the new targeting, with 0 errors and the version's key set (Workflows$UserTask with UserSource on 9.24). 11.13.0 is unchanged. Tests: TestWorkflowMutator_SetTargetingReplacesAStoredUserSource and …AddsAMissingTargeting (both failed before the fix), TestNormalize_EditedMendix9UserTaskTargeting; mdl-examples/bug-tests/1771-alter-user-task-targeting.mdl
